author: Wahiz
body:
So, I was doing my research and found out Zaidms was in my team chat and was also banned and using an alt to play. Then I confronted him about it and I was told by him that there we're about 5 mods who knew about his ban evading and how he said it they let it slide. 

Mods Names:
-Jess
-Jackson
-Luke
-Andrew
-TnTPoatoe
- Sadly Elsa does as well...

Please check into this for me.
